reason: I'd use the free visit on a Saturday and probably pay for one more if my kid loves it, since indoor options for toddlers here are thin on rainy weekends. I wouldn't commit to a pack or membership up front.
objection: I'll still be chasing my toddler, so I won't really get to sit and drink the coffee, and $15 a visit adds up when the library storytime is free.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or lower-priced drop-in, around $10, or proof after the free visit that my kid actually stays busy and I get to sit.
